title: People Ops - self notes & manager prep Q1 2026
content:
Quick notes for upcoming 1:1 with VPs + manager prep. Working draft - messy, keep as scratchpad.

Context: ramped into manager-ops scope in Oct 2025 (people ops onboarding, hiring process ownership for infra & platform). Currently focused on interview loop improvements, new grad hiring pipeline, and manager enablement docs.

Top-line ask for this 1:1: confirm promotion readiness checklist timeline and calibration plan for mid-March; get alignment on stretch project (org-level onboarding revamp) and headcount ask cadence.

Wins (recent / concrete):
- Reduced average time-to-offer from 21 -> 14 days for infra roles after new scorecard + recruiter playbook (tracked via JIRA-HR-78).
- Launched manager interview calibration sessions (pilot) with Eng infra and Platform; 8 hiring managers attended, agreement score improved from 62% -> 81% week-over-week.
- Rolled out first pass of new onboarding checklist (beta) for Dedicated team - cut first-week blocked tasks by 30% (anecdotal feedback from 3 hiring managers).
- Mentored 2 junior recruiters (Sara + Omar) - both now independently run full-cycle reqs for IC roles.

Metrics / evidence to bring:
- Hiring funnel: pipeline velocity dashboard link (Confluence page above) + time-to-offer delta by role.
- Calibration outcomes: pre/post agreement rates + sample calibration notes.
- Onboarding pilot feedback: 3 manager quotes, list of tasks removed/automated.

Areas for growth / development needs:
- Better partner with finance to get earlier visibility on hiring budgets (still reactive). Need a recurring sync and a template ask to speed approvals.
- Cross-team influence: want to deepen relationships with product PM leads to better align interview rubrics for senior PMs.
- Data/analytics: need support to instrument offer-stage reasons for faster root-cause analysis (product/infra help).

Goals (Q1 2026) - measurable & proposed timeline:
1) Promotion readiness & calibration: finalize promotion checklist + calibration rubric by 2026-03-10; run calibration session week of 2026-03-16.
2) Onboarding revamp MVP: ship revised onboarding beta for infra + dedicated teams by 2026-03-31; measure NPS from new hires at day 7 and day 30.
3) Time-to-offer: sustain <= 15 days for top priority roles (infra/platform) by end of Q1.
4) Manager enablement docs: publish 3 playbooks (interview, onboarding, first 90 days) in Confluence by 2026-03-20.

Risks / blockers:
- Need headcount approval for 1 Sr Recruiter (req 2026-HR-09) - current budget freeze could push to Q2.
- Engineering hiring managers are overloaded - calibration sessions could see low attendance without exec endorsement.
- Lack of automated instrumentation for offer rejection reasons (manual tagging slows analysis).

Questions to bring to manager:
- Can we escalate Sr Recruiter ask to hiring committee this week? Who owns that thread (you or me)?
- Agree on promotion criteria visibility: is manager ok with me circulating checklist to people managers next week for feedback?
- Exec sponsorship: can you join the opening 10 mins of calibration session to emphasize time commitment?
- Cross-functional: can we get a 30-min alignment with finance and product recruiting leads to define SLAs for approvals?

Development notes (personal):
- Recent feedback: "strong execution, needs to be more proactive on stakeholder alignment" - action: schedule 1:1s with PM leads and finance to build momentum.
- Seeking mentor: interested in connecting with someone who has run org-level onboarding at scale (ask: intro to Rachel B. or Tasha M.).

Prep agenda for 1:1 (30 min):
- 3 min: quick updates (time-to-offer, onboarding pilot NPS)
- 10 min: promotion checklist status + ask for calibration slot and team/list of reviewers
- 8 min: headcount & Sr Recruiter escalation (review email draft + next steps)
- 5 min: blockers, help needed, and agreement on next actions

Follow-ups / action items after 1:1 (draft):
- Send promotion checklist to managers (if approved) - target 2026-03-05.
- Draft headcount escalation note and loop in finance (target 2026-03-03).
- Schedule calibration session invites (target 2026-03-09).

Notes-to-self (scratch):
- Pull sample offer letters to see common decline reasons SR-2025-Q4.
- Add checklist item: "hiring manager has confirmed first-week onboarding buddy".
- Consider running a quick 15-min async calibration for managers who can't attend live.

Reference links / tickets:
- JIRA: JIRA-HR-78 (interview playbook + scorecard), 2026-HR-09 (req for Sr Recruiter)
- Confluence: Performance Calibration Q1 2026 (link above), Onboarding beta notes (internal doc id in Confluence)

Tone: candid, prep-focused. Keep iterations here; will clean up and copy to a manager-facing doc once aligned.
